admit.title: Authorize and replay
admit.summary: Require Admin, validate the key/body and look up a requester-scoped replay before resolving configuration.
talk: Require Admin, validate the key/body and look up a requester-scoped replay before resolving configuration.

authorize.title: Enforce Admin access
authorize.summary: Refresh initiation and outcome operations are checked in the application.
talk: Refresh initiation and outcome operations are checked in the application.

replay.title: Find the original request

talk: Look up the requester and key digest. Replays preserve the original admitted configuration.

transaction.title: Commit admission atomically

base.title: Validate the active base

talk: Reject unsupported or incomplete publication descriptors before admitting work.

talk: Require outcome access before reading durable run state.

flows.title: High-level diagram
flows.lead: An Admin requests a refresh. The API commits a durable run and returns a receipt, while a separate worker performs retrieval and publication.
flows.heading: Accept the request. Let the worker do the work.

lanes.title: Admit or replay a request
lanes.caption: Repeated requests from the same user with the same key return the original run.

steps.title: Request a refresh
steps.text: Send the session, mutation protection and an idempotency key with an empty body.

steps.title: Check Admin access
steps.text: Reject unsupported inputs and check for an existing matching request.

steps.title: Commit new work if needed
steps.text: Lock admission, recheck replay and availability, and freeze dates, limits and the base generation.

steps.title: Return a run receipt
steps.text: Return the run ID, effective interval and a status link; the request does no source retrieval.

lanes.title: Track the outcome
lanes.caption: The browser can read the latest run or a specific run. Status reads require Admin access too.

steps.title: Update durable progress
steps.text: The worker records stages, outcomes and publication state in PostgreSQL.

steps.title: Ask for status
steps.text: The API rechecks current access before reading run state.

steps.title: Read the run
steps.text: Read committed progress and the known publication outcome.

steps.title: Show progress or outcome
steps.text: Return current state without starting or repeating the source work.

boundaries: New HTTP runs freeze the configured start through today’s UTC date; callers do not override the dates.
An existing request replays its original configuration. Competing new work is rejected while a run occupies admission.
PostgreSQL stores the durable run. HTTP does not own the independent worker’s lifetime.
